✅ Backend APIs are 100% functional. All 4 features (F-K) tested and working:

**Feature F (DRF Items Table):**
- ✅ POST /api/drawing-requests accepts 'items' array
- ✅ Empty item names filtered out correctly
- ✅ qty_order computed as sum of item quantities
- ✅ GET returns items array
- ✅ PUT updates items and recomputes qty_order

**Feature G (Attachment Categories):**
- ✅ POST attachments accepts 'category' field (po_customer|other)
- ✅ Default category is 'other' when not specified
- ✅ Unknown categories fall back to 'other'
- ✅ GET returns category field in attachment list

**Feature I (Per-Drawing Item & Qty):**
- ✅ Drawing model accepts item_name and item_qty fields
- ✅ POST /api/drawings/{id}/drf-item endpoint works
- ✅ Permission check enforced (assignee or eng_head only)
- ✅ Values persist correctly

**Feature J (Sales TTD Auto-fill):**
- ✅ POST /api/drawings/{id}/approve/sales endpoint exists
- ✅ po_customer_no copied from DRF to drawing
- ✅ Regression: generate-drawings preserves po_customer_no

**Frontend Status:**
- ✅ Application loads correctly
- ✅ Login form present
- ⚠️ Full UI testing blocked by password field timing issue in automation (likely not a real bug)

**Recommendation:** Backend is production-ready. Frontend components (items table, attachment boxes, item picker) should be manually verified or tested with adjusted automation timing.
